description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the full lifecycle of an AI-native integration platform at enterprise customers, from discovery and implementation through production support. You will work closely with customers and a small engineering team to build reliable systems for the physical economy, turning real-world needs into improvements to the core product.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Scope, build, deploy, and maintain customer integrations in production.

 - Develop core systems for agent orchestration, runtime infrastructure, and self-healing integrations.

 - Diagnose live production issues and ship fixes directly into the product.

 - Work with customers to uncover edge cases and turn recurring needs into product and infrastructure improvements.

 - Use AI coding agents alongside sound engineering judgment to build and ship software.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of software engineering experience, with a record of owning and shipping production systems end to end.

 - Experience with customer-facing deployments or technical implementations, production debugging, and integration or backend development.

 - Proficiency in TypeScript and hands-on experience with React, Bun, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, or AWS; familiarity with Effect-TS is useful.

 - Ability to discover ambiguous customer requirements and shape them into practical technical plans.

 - Experience using AI coding agents while applying engineering judgment to review and deploy their work.

 - Enterprise systems, APIs, data transformations, EDI, logistics, or supply-chain integration experience is beneficial.

 - Comfort working independently in an early-stage, fast-paced environment.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $150,000 to $250,000 annually, plus equity. Full health coverage and equipment are provided. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States.
